cases.input: Two studies use the same approved design version with different datasets.
cases.expect: The design is reused while studies, runs, inputs and findings retain separate identity.

cases.input: The analysis intent and stopping rule change for future runs.
cases.expect: A successor design version is issued and earlier runs keep the old pin.

cases.input: Two runs of one design produce supporting and challenging outcomes.
cases.expect: Both runs and findings remain without rewriting the design or hypothesis.

cases.input: Each execution occurrence mints a new reusable design identity.
Success criteria are rewritten after result access under the same version.
A failed run removes the design from history.
A study-scoped release is promoted to a reusable design without a derivedFromStudyReleaseRef.
cases.expect: Rejected; promotion mints a new identity only with an explicit derivation link, and pre-existing run pins remain valid against the predecessor.

cases.input: An effective design version pinned by a closed run is withdrawn.
cases.expect: A DesignVersionStatusEvent is appended; the version content and the closed run's pin are unchanged and remain resolvable.

cases.input: A design version states success criteria that conflict with the pinned preregistered hypothesis criteria.
cases.expect: Rejected; WM-KNW-009 masters preregistered success and stopping criteria and the divergence must be recorded as a preregistration deviation.

cases.input: A design version used by a historical run is retired.
cases.expect: The version enters the retired state with retiredAt, validTo is set, and the historical run and its findings still resolve the pin.

cases.input: Stopping rules are edited inside an effective design version without a successor.
cases.expect: Rejected; the change alters the declared contentDigest field set and requires a successor version.
